p|panel|orbita_card_titulo: Orbit: the map of the internet
p|panel|menu_orbita_texto: Submarine and land cables, data centres and satellites, from public sources. On Windows it is a fixed tab of GUARDIANA ZERO; it is also at guardianagroup.com/orbita.
p|panel|menu_zero_texto: ZERO is GUARDIANA's browser. Open it from its «GUARDIANA ZERO» shortcut on the desktop or in the Start menu: inside it, X-rays, ZERO, Communications and Orbit are its fixed tabs.
p|panel|menu_com_texto: Encrypted chat and calls. On Windows it is a fixed tab of GUARDIANA ZERO: open it from its «GUARDIANA ZERO» shortcut and choose «Communications».
p|panel|pd_donde_texto: To draw where your data leaves from, GUARDIANA needs to know where you are. For now it only knows your country, from the time zone. You can use the location Windows measures or choose your city: it stays in this browser only and nobody on the internet is asked.

p|panel|pd_yo_aprox_texto: Only the country is known, from the system's time zone. Use Windows location or choose your city.

p|panel|pd_cortado_por_otra: A wider rule blocks it (a category or «Maximum protection»). Undo it where it was set: in Rules.
p|panel|pd_hecho_deshacer_empresa: {empresa} gets through again on this computer.
p|panel|pd_explica_asn: The public number of the network that delivers this address; it says which way it goes, not who uses the data.
p|panel|pd_explica_cifrado: This means the connection is encrypted: whoever sees it on the way cannot read what it carries.
p|panel|pd_explica_sin_cifrar: This means the connection is not encrypted: whoever sees it on the way can read what it carries.
p|panel|pd_explica_via: The protocol and the port it left through; on their own they do not say what was sent.
p|panel|pd_explica_telemetria: This means {empresa} receives usage data from this PC.
p|panel|id_intro: For every name your programs and devices connect to, GUARDIANA says who is behind it, how sure it is and why, from data that travels inside the program: it asks nobody about each name. The company behind the service is kept apart from the network that serves it: a server rented on Amazon Web Services is not Amazon’s.
p|panel|id_pct_rotulo: of what left the house, identified
p|panel|id_nivel_identificada_que: a direct source names the owner: our base, the maker, a public register or the DNS alias GUARDIANA saw
p|panel|id_nivel_probable_que: no source names the domain, but it answered from a network only that company uses, and two sources agree
p|panel|id_nivel_sin_identificar_que: nothing says who it is: the network that served it is shown
p|panel|id_probables_texto: Names no list knows that answered from a company’s own network. Probable is not certain: that is why it is kept apart.
p|panel|id_sin_texto: Names GUARDIANA cannot say who is behind. Next to each, the network that served it and what kind of network it is. If you recognize one, tell us and we will add it to the open base.
p|panel|id_sin_nombre: (no name: the program connected without asking)
p|panel|id_ediciones: Data: world companies base of {mundo}, networks list of {redes}, GUARDIANA lists of {listas}, {base} of {base_fecha}.
p|panel|id_pie: Percentages are of queries, not bytes. The company is the owner of the name or of the service that answered, never a verdict on what it does with what it receives. No list with a non-commercial license is used.

p|panel|lente_mas: How it works and its limits
p|panel|lente_estado_dns: This computer's DNS does not go through GUARDIANA yet.
p|panel|lente_registro_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what.
p|panel|lente_registro_s1: The log is your home's memory: every name asked of the internet, when, from which device and what was done with it.
p|panel|lente_registro_s2: Each row is chained to the one before. If anyone changed a single one, the check would say so.
p|panel|lente_foto_lead: What this computer asked of the internet in the last minute, by category.
p|panel|lente_foto_s1: A still picture: every name requested in the last 60 seconds, each in exactly one category.
p|panel|lente_foto_s2: That is why the breakdown adds up to the total: what the lists do not recognize goes to “Unclassified”, it is not lost.
p|panel|lente_foto_vacio: This computer has not asked the internet for anything in the last minute.
p|panel|lente_maxima_sub: Blocks the trackers, advertising and telemetry the open lists know, across the whole home.
p|panel|lente_informe_lead: Your home's last seven days, by device.
p|panel|lente_informe_s1: A summary of the week with real figures from the log, no rounding.
p|panel|lente_informe_s2: Nothing leaves home unless you share it.
p|panel|lente_informe_ejemplo: The full weekly report is part of Plus.
p|panel|lente_ct_lead: Which companies each program talks to, and what changed with each update.
p|panel|lente_ct_s1: A contract is the list of companies a program normally talks to.
p|panel|lente_ct_s2: When an update adds a new company, it shows in amber. It is not an alarm: you decide whether to keep it or block it.
p|panel|lente_ct_esperan: {n} new companies are waiting for your decision
p|panel|lente_ct_esperan_uno: 1 new company is waiting for your decision
p|panel|lente_ct_silencio: Learning quietly: no notices until there is a week to compare against.
p|panel|lente_ct_sin_cambios: No contract is waiting for your decision.
p|panel|lente_ct_linea_vacia: No program has updated in these 45 days yet.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_aprende: We are getting to know this program's usual connections.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_nuevos: This program has started asking for {n} new names.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_nuevos_uno: This program has started asking for 1 new name.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_igual: No changes seen since the last comparison.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_propio: A legitimate GUARDIANA update: not an alarm.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_propio_doc: A GUARDIANA program: its connections are documented and never raise notices.
p|panel|lente_ct_e_fijado: Fixed contract: anything not in it is blocked automatically and recorded.
p|panel|lente_revision_lead: What Windows says about this computer, read without changing anything.
p|panel|lente_revision_s1: A check-up reads how this computer is protected: who can get in, what starts on its own and where your internet goes out.
p|panel|lente_revision_s2: GUARDIANA only reads: it changes and installs nothing. Anything that appears after the first check-up is marked as new.
p|panel|lente_revision_nunca: This computer has not been checked yet.
p|panel|lente_ia_lead: Which AI services each device talks to, and when.
p|panel|lente_ia_s1: An AI agent on your computer works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network.
p|panel|lente_ia_s2: Set how far it may go and GUARDIANA tells you when it talks to anything outside that scope.
p|panel|lente_av_lead: Which addresses your antivirus talks to, and what its maker says about each one.
p|panel|lente_av_s1: Your antivirus is the program with the most access to your computer: it checks all your files.
p|panel|lente_av_s2: Someone independent has to watch the watcher. GUARDIANA only looks: your antivirus keeps protecting you.
p|panel|lente_disp_lead: What each device at home did, in totals.
p|panel|lente_disp_s1: Every device that uses GUARDIANA as its DNS shows up here with its totals.
p|panel|lente_disp_s2: A device's detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
p|panel|lente_vg_lead: What the system records about the camera, microphone, startup and privacy settings.
p|panel|lente_vg_s1: GUARDIANA keeps watching, and only watching, what the system itself records.
p|panel|lente_vg_s2: It changes nothing, reads the content of nothing, and none of this leaves your computer.
p|panel|lente_vp_lead: What each program does on the network, seen from outside.
p|panel|lente_vp_s1: Which companies each program talks to, how much it uploads and downloads.
p|panel|lente_vp_s2: Without opening anything: GUARDIANA counts, it does not decrypt.
p|panel|lente_sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where, and what it has sent out.
p|panel|lente_sabe_s1: What GUARDIANA records stays on this computer, in a single file.
p|panel|lente_sabe_s2: Below, every connection GUARDIANA itself made out of it, with its reason.
p|panel|lente_id_lead: Who is behind every name your programs connect to.
p|panel|lente_id_s1: GUARDIANA says who is behind each name, how sure it is and why.
p|panel|lente_id_s2: From data inside the program: it asks nobody about each name. A server rented on Amazon is not Amazon's.
p|panel|lente_cert_lead: A sealed certificate of your data flows, and the letters to exercise your rights.
p|panel|lente_cert_s1: The certificate states, by company, who this computer asked for in a period, with no IP addresses and no history.
